# 2、代码拉取
## 2.1 镜像源方式
### 2.1.1修改 repo 源
<callout emoji="exclamation" background-color="red" border-color="light-red">
<text color="red">**注意**</text>**：**
- <text bgcolor="red">之前做过本地 repo 配置的，或者公司有自己内网 repo 工具的，即执行 repo init 命令不需要加 --repo-url 指定临时源的，</text><text bgcolor="red">**可跳过此步骤**</text><text bgcolor="red">。</text>
</callout>

```shell
# 下载repo文件
curl https://storage.googleapis.com/git-repo-downloads/repo > repo
# 切换清华源
sed 's#https://gerrit.googlesource.com/git-repo#https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/git/git-repo#' repo > repofile
# 切换中科大源(备用，如果清华源出现不稳定情况可以替换)
sed 's#https://gerrit.googlesource.com/git-repo#https://mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/aosp/git-repo#' repo > repofile

chmod 755 repofile

sudo mv repofile `which repo`【本地repo路径，示例： mv repofile /usr/local/bin/repo】
```

### 2.1.2本地镜像拉取(ODM)
```shell {wrap}
repo init -u ssh://$(git config user.email | cut -d '@' -f1)@git.odm.mioffice.cn:29418/velaos/vendor/manifest -b q63-dev --reference=/mnt/sdb/Q63_mirror

#若提示repo init失败，执行一下指令，在重新repo init，在进行代码拉取
cp /mnt/sdb/Q63_mirror/.repo/repo ./.repo -rf

#并发线程不要超过16（即-j后的数字不要大于16），不然会被mioffice拉黑两小时，两小时无法进行代码拉取
repo sync -c -j16

#若拉代码过程中服务器VPN中断导致代码拉取失败，使用以下指令重新拉取
repo sync -c -j16 --force-sync
```

## 4.1 Flash分区
Q63使用 BES2800BP-3E7；
内置 Nor Flash共<text color="red">40MB</text>，其中Flash0 <text color="red">32MB</text>，Flash1 <text color="red">8MB</text>，用于存储code。
片外EMMC <text color="red">4GB</text> 用于存储系统相关资源。
**Flash 0**
```bash {wrap}
name                  addr            size
----------   ----------------------  --------
bootloader   0x10000000-0x10040000    256KB
bootload2    0x10040000-0x100C0000    512KB
tee          0x100C0000-0x101C0000    1MB
ap           0x101C0000–0x11F00000    29.25MB
sst          0x11F00000–0x11F80000    512KB
reserve      0x11F80000–0x12000000    512KB
```

**Flash 1**
```bash {wrap}
name                  addr            size
----------   ----------------------  --------
sensor       0x2C000000–0x2C780000    7.5MB    
misc         0x2C780000–0x2C7C0000    256KB
factory      0x2C7C0000–0x2C7C1000    4KB
```

## 4.5烧录程序
- <text bgcolor="red">**非特殊情况不要更新bootloader和bootloader2，烧录程序后，如果出现起不来的情况，需要重新烧录所有的bin**</text>
- <text bgcolor="red">**一次性烧录所有bin（包括bootloader）的时候要加-M，其他单独烧录的时候不要加-M选项**</text>

未secboot签名的机器烧录vela_bl_no_sign.bin、vela_bl2_no_sign.bin即可

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 烧录emmc镜像（cp和audio）：
注意：如板子之前已经执行过第一步，请直接从第二步操作！！！

```

#!/bin/bash
# Q63 whole-device firmware burn - Step 1: Flash images (bl/bl2/tee/ap/sensor)
# secboot signed version, DL serial = /dev/ttyACM0
# Addresses follow the official CI-generated p62_burn_flash_user_secboot.bat (0x30000000 series)

PORT=${PORT:-/dev/ttyACM0}
PROG=best2800bp_programmer.bin

echo "==> Burn Flash images (secboot signed) via $PORT"
echo "    files: vela_bl.bin / vela_bl2.bin / vela_tee.bin / vela_ap.bin / vela_sensor.bin"

$TOOL $PORT $PROG -M \
  --addr 0x30000000 ../bootloader/vela_bl.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic \
  --addr 0x30040000 ../bootloader2/vela_bl2.bin \
  --addr 0x300C0000 ../tee/vela_tee.bin \
  --addr 0x301C0000 ../ap/vela_ap.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 0 \
  --addr 0x28000000 ../sensor/vela_sensor.bin \
  --pgm-rate 2000000 --retry $RETRY --reboot

echo "==> Flash burn done (exit $?)"

#!/bin/bash
# Q63 whole-device firmware burn - Step 1: Flash images (bl/bl2/tee/ap/sensor)
# secboot signed version, DL serial = /dev/ttyACM0
# Addresses follow the official CI-generated p62_burn_flash_user_secboot.bat (0x30000000 series)
set -u
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

TOOL=./linux/m1/dldtool
PORT=${PORT:-/dev/ttyACM0}
PROG=best2800bp_programmer.bin
RETRY=${RETRY:-500}

echo "==> Burn Flash images (secboot signed) via $PORT  retry=$RETRY"
echo "    files: vela_bl.bin / vela_bl2.bin / vela_tee.bin / vela_ap.bin / vela_sensor.bin"

CMD="$TOOL $PORT $PROG -M \
  --addr 0x30000000 ../bootloader/vela_bl.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic \
  --addr 0x30040000 ../bootloader2/vela_bl2.bin \
  --addr 0x300C0000 ../tee/vela_tee.bin \
  --addr 0x301C0000 ../ap/vela_ap.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 0 \
  --addr 0x28000000 ../sensor/vela_sensor.bin \
  --pgm-rate 2000000 --retry $RETRY --reboot"

# dldtool requires a tty on stdin -> wrap with script(1)
script -qec "$CMD" /dev/null
echo "==> Flash burn finished (exit $?)"

#!/bin/bash
# Q63 whole-device burn - Step: EMMC cp/audio images
# programmer: q63_emmc_programmer_sec.bin
# addr = emmc block + 3  (per flash.py flash_emmc and emmc programmer readme)
set -u
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

TOOL=./linux/m1/dldtool
PORT=${PORT:-/dev/ttyACM0}
PROG=q63_emmc_programmer_sec.bin
RETRY=${RETRY:-500}

echo "==> Burn EMMC cp/audio images via $PORT"
echo "    cp    -> addr 2795557 (vela_cp_image.bin)"
echo "    audio -> addr 2816037 (vela_audio_image.bin)"

CMD="$TOOL $PORT $PROG \
  --addr 2795557 ../cp/vela_cp_image.bin \
  --addr 2816037 ../audio/vela_audio_image.bin \
  --pgm-rate 2000000 --retry $RETRY --reboot"

script -qec "$CMD" /dev/null
echo "==> EMMC cp/audio burn finished (exit $?)"

#!/bin/bash
# Q63 whole-device burn - Step: EMMC resources (user version, no factory)
# programmer: q63_emmc_programmer_sec.bin
# addr = emmc block + 3  (vendor 34 -> 37, system 102434 -> 102437, ...)

#!/bin/bash
# Q63 whole-device burn - Step: EMMC partition table (GPT header, block 0-34)
# This replaces the on-device "mkgpt write" shell command with a direct burn
# of the pre-built emmc_header.bin (contains protective MBR + GPT header + entries)
set -u
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

TOOL=./linux/m1/dldtool
PORT=${PORT:-/dev/ttyACM0}
PROG=q63_emmc_programmer_sec.bin
RETRY=${RETRY:-500}

echo "==> Burn EMMC partition table (emmc_header.bin) via $PORT"
echo "    addr 3 (emmc block 0 + DEV_TYPE_EMMC offset)"

CMD="$TOOL $PORT $PROG \
  --addr 3 ../emmc_images/emmc_header.bin \
  --pgm-rate 2000000 --retry $RETRY --reboot"

script -qec "$CMD" /dev/null
echo "==> EMMC partition table burn finished (exit $?)"

# Writing Skills

## Process

1. **Gather requirements** - ask user about:
   - What task/domain does the skill cover?
   - What specific use cases should it handle?
   - Does it need executable scripts or just instructions?
   - Any reference materials to include?

2. **Draft the skill** - create:
   - SKILL.md with concise instructions
   - Additional reference files if content exceeds 500 lines
   - Utility scripts if deterministic operations needed

3. **Review with user** - present draft and ask:
   - Does this cover your use cases?
   - Anything missing or unclear?
   - Should any section be more/less detailed?

## Skill Structure

```
skill-name/
├── SKILL.md           # Main instructions (required)
├── REFERENCE.md       # Detailed docs (if needed)
├── EXAMPLES.md        # Usage examples (if needed)
└── scripts/           # Utility scripts (if needed)
    └── helper.js
```

## SKILL.md Template

```md
---
name: skill-name
description: Brief description of capability. Use when [specific triggers].
---

# Skill Name

## Quick start

[Minimal working example]

## Workflows

[Step-by-step processes with checklists for complex tasks]

## Advanced features

[Link to separate files: See [REFERENCE.md](REFERENCE.md)]
```

## Description Requirements

The description is **the only thing your agent sees** when deciding which skill to load. It's surfaced in the system prompt alongside all other installed skills. Your agent reads these descriptions and picks the relevant skill based on the user's request.

**Goal**: Give your agent just enough info to know:

1. What capability this skill provides
2. When/why to trigger it (specific keywords, contexts, file types)

**Format**:

- Max 1024 chars
- Write in third person
- First sentence: what it does
- Second sentence: "Use when [specific triggers]"

**Good example**:

```
Extract text and tables from PDF files, fill forms, merge documents. Use when working with PDF files or when user mentions PDFs, forms, or document extraction.
```

**Bad example**:

```
Helps with documents.
```

The bad example gives your agent no way to distinguish this from other document skills.

## When to Add Scripts

Add utility scripts when:

- Operation is deterministic (validation, formatting)
- Same code would be generated repeatedly
- Errors need explicit handling

Scripts save tokens and improve reliability vs generated code.

## When to Split Files

Split into separate files when:

- SKILL.md exceeds 100 lines
- Content has distinct domains (finance vs sales schemas)
- Advanced features are rarely needed

## Review Checklist

After drafting, verify:

- [ ] Description includes triggers ("Use when...")
- [ ] SKILL.md under 100 lines
- [ ] No time-sensitive info
- [ ] Consistent terminology
- [ ] Concrete examples included
- [ ] References one level deep

---

  q61, q61lte, p65, p67; or mentions /dev/ttyACM, dldtool, vela_*.bin,
  emmc_images/, eMMC partitions (vendor/system/app/misc/...).
  Single source of truth: miwear.py + flash/<project>.py (programmer
  paths, image/eMMC addresses, dual-chip routing).
---

# MiWear Flash

miwear.py's flash mode handles two target families with the same `-c`
flag; the tool dispatches internally based on whether the name appears
in `images` or `emmc` of the board config.

- **image partitions**: bl, bl2, ap, cp, sensor, audio, tee
- **eMMC resources**: vendor, system, app, misc, i18n, font, watchface,
  quickapp, factory, store, nv, ... (project-specific)

Everything drives through the committed `miwear.py` — do not rely on any
developer's personal shell wrappers.

## Preflight: MUST confirm the serial ports before flashing

Port assignment is host- and board-specific (USB enumeration order,
cable ordering, board variants). **Before issuing any flash command,
you must know the two ports and the log baud rate**:

- **flash port** — where `dldtool` speaks the firmware-transfer protocol
- **log port** — where the running firmware prints / accepts commands
- **log baud** — 921600 on MiWear boards (override only when a board's
  Kconfig.debug says otherwise)

### Rule

1. If the caller (user message, parent agent, prior turn in this session,
   or a project config the skill was explicitly told to use) has already
   supplied the flash port, the log port, and the log baud, skip to the
   flash command.
2. Otherwise, **stop and ask the user to confirm all three values**
   before running any miwear.py invocation. Do not pick defaults. Do not
   proceed on "probably ACM0".

Helpful suggestions to include in the ask:

```bash
# Stable names (survive re-enumeration, great for identifying cables)
ls -l /dev/serial/by-id/ 2>/dev/null
ls /dev/ttyACM* /dev/ttyUSB* 2>/dev/null

# Peek at a candidate for log output (921600 is the MiWear default)
stty -F /dev/ttyACMx 921600 raw -echo; timeout 2 cat /dev/ttyACMx || true
```

Once confirmed, cache the triple for the rest of the session:

```bash
FLASH_PORT=...
LOG_PORT=...
LOG_BAUD=...
```

All flash invocations and reboot-trigger sequences in this skill
reference these variables. The rest of the document assumes they are
set — if they are not, go back to step 2.

Boards that auto-enter bootrom on power-up (e.g. most o62 emmc flows,
cold cable attach) only need `FLASH_PORT`; you still need to confirm
which port that is.

## Invocation contract

```bash
MIWEAR_PY=vendor/xiaomi/miwear/tools/utils/miwear.py
cd <worktree-root>
python3 "$MIWEAR_PY" -f -p <project> -t <type> -c <core>... -u "$FLASH_PORT" [-r <resource_dir>] [-l] [-b <bin_dir>]
```

- Run from the worktree root so `out/` / `cmake_out/` / `./nuttx` resolve.
- `-f` selects flash mode (required).
- Configs are loaded from
  `vendor/xiaomi/miwear/tools/utils/flash/<project>.py`.

## Argument cheatsheet

| flag | purpose | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `-f/--flash` | select flash mode | required |
| `-p/--project` | project family | p62/p65/p67/o61/o62/q61 |
| `-t/--type` | firmware variant | bt/lte/gl |
| `-c/--core` | partition or emmc key, or `all` | accepts multiple: `-c bl bl2 ap` |
| `-u/--uart` | serial port used by dldtool | pass `"$FLASH_PORT"` from the Preflight step |
| `-r/--resource` | eMMC resource dir | defaults to `./resource` |
| `-l/--lunch` | lunch bin paths | pass explicitly for lunch projects (everything except o62) |
| `-b/--bin-dir` | flat dir of `vela_*.bin` | overrides all auto path logic; handy for a pre-built bundle |

### Where miwear.py looks for the bin

1. `--bin-dir`: `{bin_dir}/vela_<core>.bin`
2. eMMC cores: `{resource_dir}/vela_<core>.bin`
3. Lunch image cores: `out/<platform>_<project>[type]_<suffix>/vela_<core>.bin`
4. Legacy cmake image cores: `cmake_out/<project>[type]_<suffix>/vela_<core>.bin`

`<suffix>` = `bootloader` / `bootloader2` for `bl` / `bl2`, otherwise the
core name.

## Board → (project, type) mapping

| board | project | type |
|---|---|---|
| p62 / o61 / q61 / p65 / p67 / o62 | same | bt |
| p62lte / o61lte / q61lte / o62lte | strip `lte` | lte |
| o62gl / p65gl / p67gl | strip `gl` | gl |

## Flash memory (`.miwear_last.json`)

After a successful flash miwear.py stores project/core/type/lunch/uart.
Next run, any omitted flag is restored. Failed flashes do not touch the
state, so a bad run never poisons defaults.

```bash
# first time: full spec
python3 "$MIWEAR_PY" -f -p o61 -t bt -c ap -u "$FLASH_PORT" -l
# subsequent reflashes after a rebuild — all flags inferred
python3 "$MIWEAR_PY" -f
# different core, keep the rest
python3 "$MIWEAR_PY" -f -c cp
```

Delete `.miwear_last.json` at the worktree root to reset.

## sudo behaviour

miwear.py uses `os.access(serial_port, R_OK|W_OK)` to decide whether to
prepend `sudo`:

- user in `dialout`/`tty` group → no sudo, no password prompt
- `/dev/ttyACM*` missing or permission-denied → sudo applied automatically

So CI/automation works without sudoers tweaks when udev/groups are set up.

## Image flashing (`-c` is one of `images` from the config)

```bash
# Single partition
python3 "$MIWEAR_PY" -f -p o61 -t bt -c ap -u "$FLASH_PORT" -l

# Multiple partitions in one dldtool session
python3 "$MIWEAR_PY" -f -p q61 -t bt -c bl bl2 ap cp sensor audio -u "$FLASH_PORT" -l

# Everything in the project's `images` table
python3 "$MIWEAR_PY" -f -p o61 -t bt -c all -u "$FLASH_PORT" -l
```

Internally miwear.py calls
`sudo? {dldtool} {port} {programmer} [-M addr bin]... --no-default-magic --reboot`,
grouping by `flash0_core` vs `flash1_core` (dual-chip routing) and using
the programmer/dldtool configured per board.

## eMMC resource flashing (`-c` is one of `emmc` from the config)

eMMC entries are flashed with a different programmer (`emmc_programmer`)
and a different address scheme.

```bash
# Single resource
python3 "$MIWEAR_PY" -f -p o62 -c app -u "$FLASH_PORT" -r ./emmc_images

# All resources defined for the project
python3 "$MIWEAR_PY" -f -p o62 -c all -u "$FLASH_PORT" -r ./emmc_images
```

miwear.py will **not** mix images and emmc cores in one invocation — pass
one family at a time.

## Alias resolution

If a short name doesn't exist in `images` or `emmc` but `{name}_image`
does, miwear.py silently rewrites it. E.g. `-c cp` on p62 resolves to
`cp_image`.

## Flash flow with reboot trigger

Some boards only enter flash mode after the running firmware receives a
`reboot` command on the log port. Uses the `FLASH_PORT` / `LOG_PORT` /
`LOG_BAUD` from Preflight:

```bash
# 1. Start dldtool waiting for SYNC (background, so we can trigger reboot next)
tmux new-session -d -s flash \
  "cd <worktree-root> && python3 vendor/xiaomi/miwear/tools/utils/miwear.py -f -p <project> -t <type> -c <core> -u $FLASH_PORT -l"

# 2. Kick the running firmware into flash mode over the log port
stty -F "$LOG_PORT" "$LOG_BAUD" raw -echo
printf "reboot\r" > "$LOG_PORT"

# 3. Watch until the pane exits
tmux capture-pane -p -t flash -S -30
# "can't find pane: flash" means flash finished (success or failure)
```

Boards that auto-enter bootrom on power-up (most o62 eMMC flows, cold
cable attach) skip step 2 — just run the miwear.py command with
`-u "$FLASH_PORT"` directly.

## What to check when flashing fails

1. **"xxx is not exist, continue"** — bin file not produced by the
   corresponding build. Run miwear-build first and confirm the `out/`
   (lunch) or `cmake_out/` (o62) path matches the project+type+core.
2. **Stuck at "Wait for SYNC"** — device isn't in flash mode. Send `reboot`
   via the log port again; power-cycle if that still fails.
3. **Permission denied on the serial device** — add yourself to dialout
   (`sudo usermod -aG dialout $USER && newgrp dialout`) or let miwear.py
   fall back to sudo automatically.
4. **Project not supported** —
   `ls vendor/xiaomi/miwear/tools/utils/flash/*.py` lists what's on this
   worktree. Missing project = sync the right manifest.
5. **"please split to flash"** — you mixed image and emmc cores in one
   invocation. Flash images first, then resources.
6. **Wrong dual-chip routing** — flash hangs with `set-dual-chip` errors;
   cross-check `flash0_core` / `flash1_core` in `flash/<project>.py`
   against the hardware schematic.

## Related skills

- `miwear-build` — produce the bins before flashing.
- `miwear-run` — for cores that target a simulator instead of hardware.
- `miwear-rc` — after flashing, drive the booted device to verify.
- `tmux` — coordinating reboot + flash across two serial ports.

## Q63 specifics (BES2800BP)

Q63 shares the BES2800BP chip and flash/eMMC layout with p62 — the
`q63.py` config reuses p62's `images`/`emmc` addresses and differs only
in the eMMC programmer (`q63_emmc_programmer_sec.bin`). Three gotchas
from the whole-device burn session:

1. **Burn address is `0x10000000`, not `0x30000000`.** The CI-generated
   `p62_burn_flash_*.bat` uses the `0x30000000` series — that's a p62
   template leftover and equals `FLASH_NC_BASE`, NOT the burn address.
   The correct series is `0x10000000` (bl) / `0x10040000` (bl2) /
   `0x100C0000` (tee) / `0x101C0000` (ap) / `0x2C000000` (sensor), which
   matches `FLASH_BASE=0x10000000` printed at boot. `q63.py` already
   encodes the correct values — don't override them with the .bat numbers.

2. **eMMC partition = burn `emmc_header.bin` to addr 3.** The daily
   full-package ships `emmc_images/emmc_header.bin`, a pre-built GPT
   header (`EFI PART` signature, 34 blocks covering LBA 0-34). Burning it
   to addr 3 (block 0 + DEV_TYPE_EMMC offset) replaces the on-device
   `mkgpt write` shell command, so partitioning works even when the AP
   hasn't booted a shell yet.

3. **AP stuck at `OTA_BOOT` → `reboot` on the log port won't work.** Until
   the eMMC is partitioned, the AP hangs in early init (no NSH shell), so
   the reboot-trigger flow can't fire. Power-cycle (VBUS off/on) is the
   reliable way to enter bootrom DL mode in this state.
```

## Q63 specifics (BES2800BP)

Q63 shares the BES2800BP chip and flash/eMMC layout with p62 — `q63.py`
reuses p62's `images`/`emmc` addresses and differs only in the eMMC

   `p62_burn_flash_*.bat` ships the `0x30000000` series — a p62 template
   leftover equal to `FLASH_NC_BASE`, NOT the burn address. Correct series:
   bl `0x10000000` / bl2 `0x10040000` / tee `0x100C0000` / ap `0x101C0000`
   / sensor `0x2C000000`, matching boot log `FLASH_BASE=0x10000000`.
   `q63.py` already encodes these — don't override with the .bat numbers.

2. **eMMC partition = burn `emmc_header.bin` to addr 3.** The daily
   full-package ships `emmc_images/emmc_header.bin`, a pre-built GPT header
   (`EFI PART` signature, 34 blocks = LBA 0-34). Burning it to addr 3
   (block 0 + DEV_TYPE_EMMC offset) replaces the on-device `mkgpt write`
   shell command, so partitioning works even before the AP has a shell.

3. **AP stuck at `OTA_BOOT` → log-port `reboot` won't fire.** Until the
   eMMC is partitioned the AP hangs in early init (no NSH shell), so the
   reboot-trigger flow can't run. Power-cycle (VBUS off/on) is the reliable
   way to enter bootrom DL mode in this state.

2	name: device-q61

6	
7	# BES 平台编译与刷机（O61 / Q61）
8	
9	支持 O61 和 Q61 两种设备（BES2800BP 芯片，best1700_ep 平台），BT/LTE 型号，涵盖编译、刷机、线上拉取固件、大核升级小核等场景。
10	
11	> 高级用户或遇到刷机故障时，参考 `$SKILL_DIR/references/params.md` 获取板级映射、dldtool 参数、故障排查等细节。
12	
13	## Manifest (machine-readable contract)
14	
15	> 本段是 device-skill **manifest 契约 v1.0**（机器可读），供 `module-dev` 职能 agent 及其 worker 按 schema 解析。manifest 是**能力声明**，不是命令仓库——完整命令体仍唯一住在本 SKILL.md 命令章节、`scripts/` 与 `references/`；`invocation` 只放带占位骨架。可选字段缺省 = 该品类无此能力，consumer 跳过对应步骤。
16	>
17	> device-q61 是 **script 载体**形态：build/flash 都走封装脚本（`scripts/build.sh`、`scripts/flash.sh`，按 `-D o61|q61` `-t bt|lte` 选板级/型号）；**双设备双通道**——Q61=dldtool USB 串口线刷，O61=adb 大核升级小核（channels 列并集，module-dev 按注入 board 选 default_channel）。**省略** worktree / sil / 品类级 preconditions。
18	
19	```yaml
20	schema_version: "1.0"
21	category: device-q61             # == skill 目录名，与注入的 device_skill 名互校验
22	
23	build:
24	  carrier: script                # build_md | inline | script —— 封装在 scripts/build.sh
25	  command_doc: build             # script 载体下命令由 invocation 自带，无独立 build.md
26	  invocation: "bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/build.sh [-D o61|q61] [-t bt|lte] [-m <模块,逗号分隔>] [--no-clean]"
27	                                 # 模块缩写 bl/bl2/ap/cp/sensor/audio；编译/刷机 -D/-t 必须一致
28	  artifact_glob: "out/bes_<BOARD>_<module>/vela_<module>.bin"
29	                                 # <BOARD>=q61|o61|o61lte，<module>=全称 bootloader/ap/audio
30	
31	flash:
32	  channels:
33	    - method: dldtool            # Q61：USB 串口线刷（dldtool 直连），须实 TTY
34	      command_doc: flash         # → scripts/flash.sh + params.md
35	      invocation: "bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh [-t bt|lte] [-m <模块>]"   # 默认 -D q61
36	      baud: 921600               # Q61_BAUDRATE 默认 921600
37	      transport: usb
38	    - method: adb                # O61：adb 大核升级小核（adb 推送 + 大核 dldtool）
39	      command_doc: flash         # → scripts/flash.sh -D o61 + params.md
40	      invocation: "bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh -D o61 [-t bt|lte] [-m <模块>]"
41	      baud: 2000000              # O61_BAUDRATE 默认 2000000
42	      transport: net             # adb over USB/网络
43	  default_channel: dldtool       # 默认 Q61；注入 board=o61 时 module-dev 切 adb
44	  partition_model:
45	    partitions: [bl, bl2, ap, cp, sensor, audio]
46	    targets:
47	      all: [bl, bl2, ap, cp, audio, sensor]   # 刷机顺序 bl→bl2→ap→cp→audio→sensor
48	      ap: [ap]
49	      audio: [audio]
50	    target_rules: flash          # 模块→地址映射详见 references/params.md
51	    artifacts:
52	      bl: bl.bin
53	      bl2: bl2.bin
54	      ap: vela_ap.bin
55	      cp: vela_cp.bin
56	      sensor: vela_sensor.bin
57	      audio: vela_audio.bin
58	  default_target: all
59	
60	references:                      # 角色键→文件名映射；缺某键 = 该能力此品类不存在
61	  flash: params.md               # 板级映射 / dldtool 参数 / 故障排查（无独立 flash-commands.md）
62	
63	remote:
64	  supported: false
65	
66	# 省略字段（= 能力不存在，consumer 跳过）：build.compilers/ci_invocation / test / worktree / preconditions / references.{sil,review_rules,...}
67	```
68	
69	## 脚本与资源
70	
71	`SKILL_DIR` 指当前 skill 安装目录，默认为 `.claude/skills/device-q61`。脚本中 `SKILL_DIR` 自动指向 skill 所在目录，无需手动调整。
72	
73	- 编译脚本：`$SKILL_DIR/scripts/build.sh`（支持 `-D o61/q61`）
74	- 刷机脚本：`$SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh`（支持 `-D o61/q61`）
75	- 参数参考：`$SKILL_DIR/references/params.md`（板级映射、地址、故障排查）
76	
77	## 基本概念
78	
79	| 概念 | 说明 |
80	|------|------|
81	| 设备 | `q61`（默认）或 `o61`，通过 `-D` 参数指定 |
82	| 型号 | `bt`（默认）或 `lte`，通过 `-t` 参数指定 |
83	| 模块 | 缩写或全称皆可：`bl`/`bootloader`, `bl2`/`bootloader2`, `ap`, `cp`, `sensor`, `audio`。刷机按此顺序执行：bl → bl2 → ap → cp → audio → sensor |
84	| 编译方式 | `source build/envsetup.sh` → `lunch` → `m` |
85	| 刷机方式 | **Q61: USB 串口线刷**（dldtool 直连）；**O61: adb 大核升级小核**（adb 推送 + 大核 dldtool） |
86	| 默认串口 | `/dev/ttyACM0`（Q61 刷机端口），`/dev/ttyACM1`（Q61 日志/命令端口） |
87	
88	## 环境变量
89	
90	| 变量 | 说明 |
91	|------|------|
92	| `Q61_BAUDRATE` | Q61 串口波特率，默认 921600 |
93	| `O61_BAUDRATE` | O61 串口波特率，默认 2000000 |
94	| `FLASH_TIMEOUT` | 刷机超时秒数，默认 300（全模块约 2-3 分钟，单模块通常 < 1 分钟） |
95	| `FORCE_KILL` | ⚠️ **风险选项**：设为 1 自动终止占用串口的所有进程（含 screen/tmux 会话）。**仅限无人值守的 CI 环境**，手动调试环境禁止使用 |
96	
97	## ⚠️ 风险警告
98	
99	- **硬件要求**：必须直接连接主机 USB 口，**严禁使用 USB hub**，供电不稳可能导致固件损坏
100	- **参数一致性**：编译与刷机的 `-D`（设备）和 `-t`（型号）参数必须匹配，`-m` 可以是编译模块的子集。不匹配可能导致设备变砖
101	- **宿主机执行**：刷机必须在宿主机执行（需直接访问 `/dev/ttyACM*`），编译可在 docker 内执行
102	- **刷机方式区别**：**Q61 = USB 串口线刷**，**O61 = adb 大核升级小核**，两者流程完全不同
103	
104	## 场景一：编译
105	
106	```bash
107	# Q61 BT 全编
108	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/build.sh
109	
110	# Q61 LTE 全编
111	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/build.sh -t lte
112	
113	# 单编 audio
114	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/build.sh -m audio
115	
116	# 单编 ap + audio，不 distclean
117	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/build.sh --no-clean -m ap,audio
118	
119	# O61 BT 全编
120	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/build.sh -D o61
121	
122	# O61 单编 audio
123	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/build.sh -D o61 -m audio
124	```
125	
126	产物路径：`out/bes_<BOARD>_<MODULE>/vela_<MODULE>.bin`
127	（`<BOARD>` 为板级名如 q61/o61lte，`<MODULE>` 为模块全称如 bootloader/ap/audio，与 `-m` 参数的缩写 bl/bl2 不同）
128	
129	## 场景二：刷机
130	
131	**前置条件**：
132	- Q61：设备通过 USB 连接，`ls /dev/ttyACM*` 可见串口设备
133	- O61：`adb devices` 显示设备状态为 `device`（首次需授权，见 `$SKILL_DIR/references/params.md`）
134	
135	> ⚠️ 脚本会自动检测串口占用，交互模式需确认 kill 进程，CI 环境设置 `FORCE_KILL=1` 跳过。
136	
137	### 编译产物刷机
138	
139	从本地编译产物 `out/` 目录刷机。若找不到 bin 文件将报错退出，不会尝试其他路径。
140	
141	```bash
142	# Q61 全刷（USB 串口线刷）
143	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh
144	
145	# 单刷 audio
146	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh -m audio
147	
148	# 刷 ap + cp
149	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh -m ap,cp
150	
151	# LTE 型号
152	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh -t lte
153	
154	# 指定串口
155	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh -p /dev/ttyACM1
156	```
157	
158	编译 + 刷机一条龙（使用 `&&` 连接，编译失败时不会执行刷机）：
159	```bash
160	# ⚠️ -D/-t 参数必须一致，-m 可以是编译模块的子集
161	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/build.sh -t lte && bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh -t lte
162	```
163	
164	### 线上拉取固件刷机
165	
166	从远程 URL 或本地压缩包下载固件，解压后直接刷机。支持 `.tar.gz`, `.tgz`, `.tar.bz2`, `.tar.xz`, `.tar`, `.zip`。
167	
168	```bash
169	# 远程 URL 全刷
170	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh -u https://xxx/mcu_bins.tar.gz
171	
172	# 本地压缩包全刷
173	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh -u /path/to/package.zip
174	
175	# 本地压缩包单刷 audio
176	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh -u /path/to/package.zip -m audio
177	
178	# 从指定本地目录刷机
179	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh -d /tmp/mcu_bins
180	```
181	
182	固件查找顺序：`-u/-d` 指定目录 > 编译产物 `out/` 目录（详见 `$SKILL_DIR/references/params.md`）。
183	
184	### 大核升级小核（O61）
185	
186	O61 设备通过 **adb 在大核上使用 dldtool 升级小核**（与 Q61 的 USB 串口线刷完全不同）。脚本中 `-D o61` 自动走 adb 路径。
187	
188	> ⚠️ **前置条件：adb 授权**（详细步骤见 `$SKILL_DIR/references/params.md`）
189	
190	```bash
191	# O61 全部模块（adb 大核升级小核）
192	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh -D o61
193	
194	# O61 单模块
195	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh -D o61 -m ap,audio
196	
197	# O61 编译 + 刷机一条龙
198	bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/build.sh -D o61 -m audio && bash $SKILL_DIR/scripts/flash.sh -D o61 -m audio
199	```
200	
201	手动操作步骤详见 `$SKILL_DIR/references/params.md`。
202	
203	## 注意事项
204	
205	- **仅支持 O61/Q61 设备**（BT/LTE 型号），不支持其他设备如 O62
206	- **Q61 双串口机制**：ttyACM0 为刷机端口，ttyACM1 为日志/命令端口。刷机时 dldtool 占用 ttyACM0 等待 SYNC，reboot 通过 ttyACM1 发送
207	- **串口权限**：权限不足时执行 `sudo usermod -aG dialout $USER` 后需注销会话或重启系统生效
208	- 刷机失败恢复：若刷机命令执行后 30 秒仍显示 "Waiting for SYNC" 且无进度更新，按 Ctrl+C 中断后断电重启。详细故障排查见 `$SKILL_DIR/references/params.md`
209

thinking:
现在我理解了 device skill 的结构。device-q61 的 SKILL.md 包含：
1. Manifest (machine-readable contract) - yaml 契约
2. 脚本与资源
3. 基本概念
4. 环境变量
5. 风险警告
6. 场景一：编译
7. 场景二：刷机
8. 注意事项

而且 device-q61 是"script 载体"形态，有 scripts/build.sh 和 scripts/flash.sh。

关键观察：
- device-q61 覆盖 Q61 和 O61（BES2800BP 芯片，best1700_ep 平台）
- 它用 `-D o61|q61` 参数区分设备
- Q61 = USB 串口线刷（dldtool），O61 = adb 升级

现在 Q63 的情况：
- Q63 也是 BES2800BP 芯片，best1700_ep 平台（我们验证了 CHIP=best1700）
- Q63 的编译 config：vendor/bes/boards/best1700_ep/q63/configs/
- Q63 的刷机：USB 串口线刷（dldtool，同 Q61）

所以 Q63 和 Q61 非常相似（同芯片，同刷机方式 USB 串口线刷）。

关键问题：是否需要独立的 device-q63？

让我分析：

1. **从 CLAUDE.md 路由表角度**：路由表要求"每个 device-* skill 必须在路由表有对应条目"，且"板级关键词缺失/歧义时询问用户"。Q63 目前不在路由表，用户提到 Q63 时无法路由到 device skill。

2. **从硬件角度**：Q63 与 Q61 同芯片（BES2800BP/best1700_ep），同刷机方式（USB 串口 dldtool）。但 Q63 是独立型号，有独立的 config 目录（q63 vs q61）。

3. **从 R10 撞车规避规则**：CLAUDE.md 说"通用动作词不得作为 device_skill 主键；多产品共用的芯片名不得作主键，只用型号专名区分"。所以 Q63 应该用型号专名 Q63 作主键。

结论：**需要 device-q63 skill**，因为：
1. Q63 是独立型号，用户会单独提到 Q63
2. 路由表需要 device-q63 才能把 Q63 任务路由到正确的 device skill
3. Q63 有独立的编译 config（q63 目录）、独立的刷机地址（虽然和 P62 同芯片，但刷机用 q63_emmc_programmer_sec.bin）

但是，这里有一个关键的设计选择：
- **选项 A**：新建独立的 device-q63 skill（类似 device-q61）
- **选项 B**：把 Q63 合并到现有的 device skill（比如 device-q61 加 Q63，或 device-p62 加 Q63）

从 CLAUDE.md 的路由表规则看，Q61/O61 用 device-q61（独立 skill），P62 用 device-p62。Q63 同 Q61/O61 一样，应该用独立的 device-q63。

# Device P62

Flash, build, debug, and monitor P62/P62LTE hardware (BES2800BP) running Vela/NuttX.

## Manifest (machine-readable contract)

> 本段是 device-skill **manifest 契约 v1.0**（机器可读），供 `module-dev` 职能 agent 及其 worker（build/flash/test）按 schema 解析。manifest 是**能力声明**，不是命令仓库——完整命令体仍唯一住在本 SKILL.md 命令章节与 `references/`；`invocation` 只放带占位的命令骨架。可选字段缺省 = 该品类无此能力，consumer 跳过对应步骤。
>
> device-p62 是**穿戴极简形态**：inline build（`lunch`+`m`，无独立 build.md）+ dldtool/openocd 双通道，**省略** caros 专属的 worktree / sil / 品类级 preconditions / review_rules 等整块。同一 schema 覆盖两极。

```yaml
schema_version: "1.0"
category: device-p62             # == skill 目录名，与注入的 device_skill 名互校验

build:
  carrier: inline                # build_md | inline | script —— p62 命令内联在 SKILL.md「Quick Build」章节
  command_doc: build             # inline 载体下无 references.build 键，consumer 回退读 SKILL.md 命令章节
  invocation: "source build/envsetup.sh && lunch vendor/bes/boards/best1700_ep/p62/configs/<core> && m -j<N>"
                                 # 多核按序：tee → ap → cp → sensor → audio（tee 必须先于 ap）
  artifact_glob: "out/bes_p62_<core>/vela_*.bin"
                                 # _test 配置时落 out/bes_p62_<core>_test/，两路径都搜

flash:
  channels:
    - method: dldtool            # NOR programmer + eMMC programmer 两套；须在 tmux 内跑（isatty）
      command_doc: flash         # → flash-commands.md
      invocation: "chmod 666 <flash_port> && ./dldtool <flash_port> <programmer.bin> [--addr <addr> <bin>]... --no-default-magic [--reboot]"
      baud: 921600               # 串口侧 reboot-then-flash 用；dldtool 本身走 USB CDC ACM
      transport: usb
    - method: openocd            # JLink SWD，nxflash 优先（按分区名寻址）/ flash_algo 兜底
      command_doc: flash         # → flash-commands.md（OpenOCD/nxflash 章节）
      invocation: "<openocd + JLink SWD: nxflash stub 按分区名寻址 | 兜底 flash write_image erase / emmc_write>"
      transport: swd
  default_channel: dldtool
  partition_model:               # 多分区按分区名寻址（NOR + eMMC），非 caros 式 bl/bmp/corecs 三段
    partitions: [bl, tee, ap, cp, sensor, audio, resources]
    targets:
      ap: [ap, tee]              # TEE 不能单刷，必与 AP 同刷（Critical Rule 5）
      nor_all: [ap, tee, sensor] # "flash all NOR"（不含 bootloader，安全默认）
      sensor: [sensor]
      resources: [resources]     # eMMC 资源
    target_rules: flash          # 分区→programmer/地址映射详见 flash-commands.md
    artifacts:
      bl: bl2.bin
      tee: vela_tee.bin
      ap: vela_ap.bin
      cp: vela_cp.bin
      sensor: vela_sensor.bin
      audio: vela_audio.bin
  default_target: nor_all

references:                      # 角色键→文件名映射；缺某键 = 该能力此品类不存在，consumer 跳过
  flash: flash-commands.md
  storage: storage-layout.md     # eMMC 分区表/地址（partition_model.target_rules 的补充事实表）

input.content:
---
name: device-q63
description: "Q63 BES 设备编译与刷机（BES2800BP/best1700_ep，与 P62 同芯片）。触发：Q63/q63 设备、vendor/bes/boards/best1700_ep/q63、q63 编译/烧录/flash/刷机、q63_emmc_programmer。用型号专名 Q63 作主键（芯片名 best2800bp/best1700 归 device-p62），避免撞车。"
---

# Device Q63

Q63 穿戴设备（BES2800BP 芯片，best1700_ep 平台，BT 型号）。与 P62 同芯片、同 flash/eMMC 布局，但编译 config 目录（`best1700_ep/q63`）和 eMMC programmer（`q63_emmc_programmer_sec.bin`）独立。

> 刷机也可走 `miwear-flash` skill 的 `miwear.py -p q63`（配置在 `vendor/xiaomi/miwear/tools/utils/flash/q63.py`）。

## Manifest (machine-readable contract)

> 本段是 device-skill **manifest 契约 v1.0**（机器可读），供 `module-dev` 职能 agent 及其 worker 按 schema 解析。manifest 是**能力声明**，不是命令仓库——完整命令体唯一住在本 SKILL.md 命令章节。可选字段缺省 = 该品类无此能力，consumer 跳过对应步骤。
>
> device-q63 是**穿戴 inline 形态**：inline build（`./build.sh --cmake`）+ dldtool 单通道。**省略** worktree / sil / 品类级 preconditions / references 整块。

```yaml
schema_version: "1.0"
category: device-q63             # == skill 目录名，与注入的 device_skill 名互校验

build:
  carrier: inline                # build_md | inline | script —— q63 命令内联在本 SKILL.md
  command_doc: build             # inline 载体下无 references.build 键
  invocation: "./build.sh vendor/bes/boards/best1700_ep/q63/configs/<core> -e -Werror --cmake -j12"
                                 # 多核按序：tee → ap → cp → sensor → audio → ota → bootloader → bootloader2 → recovery
                                 # tee 必须先于 ap（ap 依赖 vela_tee.se）
  artifact_glob: "cmake_out/q63_<core>/vela_*.bin"

flash:
  channels:
    - method: dldtool            # NOR programmer + eMMC programmer 两套；须伪终端包裹（isatty）
      command_doc: flash         # 命令内联在本 SKILL.md「刷机」章节
      invocation: "./dldtool <flash_port> <programmer.bin> [--addr <addr> <bin>]... --pgm-rate 2000000 [--reboot]"
      baud: 921600               # 串口侧 reboot-then-flash 用；dldtool 本身走 USB CDC ACM
      transport: usb
  default_channel: dldtool
  partition_model:
    partitions: [bl, bl2, tee, ap, sensor, cp, audio, resources]
    targets:
      all: [bl, bl2, tee, ap, sensor]   # NOR 全刷（含 bootloader，整机烧录时用）
      ap: [ap]
      sensor: [sensor]
      emmc: [cp, audio]                 # eMMC 镜像
      resources: [resources]            # eMMC 资源分区
    target_rules: flash          # 分区→地址映射见「刷机」章节地址表
    artifacts:
      bl: vela_bl.bin
      bl2: vela_bl2.bin
      tee: vela_tee.bin
      ap: vela_ap.bin
      cp: vela_cp_image.bin
      sensor: vela_sensor.bin
      audio: vela_audio_image.bin
  default_target: all

# 省略字段（= 能力不存在）：build.compilers / test / worktree / preconditions / references / remote
```

## 基本概念

| 项 | 值 |
|----|----|
| 芯片 | BES2800BP-3E7（best1700_ep 平台） |
| Flash | 40MB Nor（Flash0 32MB + Flash1 8MB，dual-chip） |
| eMMC | 4GB（系统资源 + cp/audio 镜像） |
| 双串口 | `ttyACM0` 刷机端口（dldtool），`ttyACM1` 日志/命令端口 |
| 波特率 | 921600（串口侧）；dldtool 走 USB CDC ACM |
| 烧录工具 | `vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool`（或 `2800bp/dldtool`） |

## 编译

```bash
# 首次：先编译 tee（ap 依赖 vela_tee.se），再编译其余核
./build.sh vendor/bes/boards/best1700_ep/q63/configs/tee       -e -Werror --cmake -j12
./build.sh vendor/bes/boards/best1700_ep/q63/configs/ap        -e -Werror --cmake -j12
./build.sh vendor/bes/boards/best1700_ep/q63/configs/cp        -e -Werror --cmake -j12
./build.sh vendor/bes/boards/best1700_ep/q63/configs/sensor    -e -Werror --cmake -j12
./build.sh vendor/bes/boards/best1700_ep/q63/configs/audio     -e -Werror --cmake -j12
./build.sh vendor/bes/boards/best1700_ep/q63/configs/ota       -e -Werror --cmake -j12
./build.sh vendor/bes/boards/best1700_ep/q63/configs/bootloader  -e -Werror --cmake -j12
./build.sh vendor/bes/boards/best1700_ep/q63/configs/bootloader2 -e -Werror --cmake -j12
./build.sh vendor/bes/boards/best1700_ep/q63/configs/recovery  -e -Werror --cmake -j12
```

产物路径：`cmake_out/q63_<core>/vela_*.bin`（`<core>` 全称，如 `q63_ap/vela_ap.bin`、`q63_bootloader/vela_bl.bin`）。

清除产物：`rm -rf cmake_out/q63_<core>`，或 `./build.sh ... distclean`。

## 刷机

### NOR Flash 镜像（bl/bl2/tee/ap/sensor）

secboot 签名版（`vela_bl.bin`/`vela_bl2.bin`）；未签名机器改用 `_no_sign` 后缀。

```bash
sudo ./dldtool /dev/ttyACM0 best2800bp_programmer.bin -M \
  --addr 0x10000000 vela_bl.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic \
  --addr 0x10040000 vela_bl2.bin \
  --addr 0x100C0000 vela_tee.bin \
  --addr 0x101C0000 vela_ap.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 0 \
  --addr 0x2C000000 vela_sensor.bin \
  --pgm-rate 2000000 --reboot
```

### eMMC cp/audio 镜像

```bash
sudo ./dldtool /dev/ttyACM0 q63_emmc_programmer_sec.bin \
  --addr 2795557 vela_cp_image.bin \
  --addr 2816037 vela_audio_image.bin \
  --pgm-rate 2000000 --reboot
```

### eMMC 分区表（GPT 头）

`emmc_header.bin`（含 `EFI PART` 签名，覆盖 LBA 0-34）直烧到 addr 3，等价设备端 `mkgpt write`，无需先跑起 shell。

```bash
sudo ./dldtool /dev/ttyACM0 q63_emmc_programmer_sec.bin \
  --addr 3 emmc_header.bin --pgm-rate 2000000 --reboot
```

### eMMC 资源分区

```bash
sudo ./dldtool /dev/ttyACM0 q63_emmc_programmer_sec.bin \
  --addr 37        vela_vendor.bin \
  --addr 102437    vela_system.bin \
  --addr 409637    vela_app.bin \
  --addr 819237    vela_health.bin \
  --addr 1331237   vela_misc.bin \
  --addr 1536037   vela_i18n.bin \
  --addr 1597477   vela_font.bin \
  --addr 1740837   vela_watchface.bin \
  --addr 2150437   vela_quickapp.bin \
  --addr 2662437   vela_store.bin \
  --pgm-rate 2000000 --reboot
```

### 地址表（block 号 +3 = 烧录地址）

| 分区 | 起始 block | 烧录 addr | 说明 |
|------|-----------|----------|------|
| vendor | 34 | 37 | GPT 头后首个分区 |
| system | 102434 | 102437 | |
| app | 409634 | 409637 | |
| health | 819234 | 819237 | |
| misc | 1331234 | 1331237 | |
| i18n | 1536034 | 1536037 | |
| font | 1597474 | 1597477 | |
| watchface | 1740834 | 1740837 | |
| quickapp | 2150434 | 2150437 | |
| factory | 2457634 | 2457637 | 生产版本才有 |
| store | 2662434 | 2662437 | |
| cp_image | 2795554 | 2795557 | |
| audio_image | 2816034 | 2816037 | |

## 整机烧录顺序

1. NOR Flash 镜像（bl/bl2/tee/ap/sensor）
2. eMMC 分区表（`emmc_header.bin` → addr 3）
3. eMMC cp/audio 镜像
4. eMMC 资源分区
5. `setprop persist.setup_wizard 1` 跳配对界面（可选）

## 关键坑（实测）

1. **烧录地址是 `0x10000000`，不是 `0x30000000`** —— CI 打包的 `p62_burn_flash_*.bat` 用 `0x30000000` 系列是 p62 模板遗留（实为 `FLASH_NC_BASE`）。正确系列：bl `0x10000000` / bl2 `0x10040000` / tee `0x100C0000` / ap `0x101C0000` / sensor `0x2C000000`。证据：启动日志 `FLASH_BASE=0x10000000, FLASH_NC_BASE=0x30000000`。

2. **eMMC 分区 = 直烧 `emmc_header.bin` 到 addr 3** —— 预生成 GPT 头，免去设备端 `mkgpt write` shell 命令。即使 AP 还没跑起 shell 也能分区。

3. **AP 卡 `OTA_BOOT` 时 log 口 `reboot` 无效** —— eMMC 未分区导致 AP 卡在早期 init（无 NSH shell），reboot-trigger 流程走不通。此状态下可靠进入 bootrom DL 模式的方式是**物理断电上电**（VBUS 断/开）。

4. **dldtool 需伪终端** —— dldtool 检测 stdin 是否 tty（`isatty`），非终端下直接退出。用 `script -qec "<cmd>" /dev/null` 或 tmux 包裹。

5. **首次编译先 tee 后 ap** —— ap 依赖 `vela_tee.se`，顺序错会报 `missing and no known rule to make it`。

## 烧录失败自查

- 串口速率过低？试更低速率
- TX/RX 接反？DL 串口和 DEBUG 串口接反？
- 串口调试工具未关端口（占用）
- GND 共地未接好
- 产品板不接带 LED 的 FPC 小板，直接主板 Vbus 供电
- 不接屏幕（防 FPC/屏幕外设干扰刷机）

## 分析结论：只需烧 **AP 核** 的 debug 版本

### 1. Q63 核架构与串口归属

Q63（BES2800BP）共 6 个核，镜像分布如下：

| 核 | 职责 | 镜像位置 | 是否跑串口 console |
|----|------|---------|------------------|
| **ap**（M55 C0） | 主控 + **NSH shell** | NOR `0x101C0000` | ✅ **唯一串口 console** |
| tee | 安全核（secboot） | NOR `0x100C0000` | ❌ |
| sensor | 传感器核 | NOR `0x2C000000` | ❌ |
| cp | 蓝牙核 | EMMC `cp_image` | ❌ |
| audio | 音频核 | EMMC `audio_image` | ❌ |
| bl / bl2 | bootloader | NOR `0x10000000`/`0x10040000` | ❌ |

串口交互 shell 由 AP 核的 `CONFIG_LPUART0_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y` + `CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y`（prompt `ap> `）提供；其他核的日志是经 RPMSG 发给 AP 的 `SYSLOG_RPMSG_SERVER` 汇总后再输出到串口，**它们不直接提供串口输入**。

### 2. release 版为什么串口不能输入

对比 `ap`（debug）vs `ap_f`（factory/release）：

| 配置 | ap（debug） | ap_f（release） |
|------|-----------|----------------|
| shell 通道 | 串口 NSH | **ADB shell**（`CONFIG_ADBD_SHELL_SERVICE=y` + `CONFIG_SYSTEM_ADBD=y`） |
| 优化 | `-Os` | `-O3` |
| prompt | `ap> ` | `ap_f> ` |

release 版（ap_f）额外启用了 `ADBD_SHELL_SERVICE`——shell 走 ADB（USB），串口只作为 syslog 日志输出、不响应输入命令（这正是之前烧 release 包后 ttyACM1 发 `help`/`reboot` 无响应的原因）。debug 版（ap）没有 ADB，NSH 直接绑在串口上，可正常输入输出。

### 3. 需要烧哪些核

**只有 AP 核一个镜像**（其余核不影响串口交互，可保持现状）：

| 核 | 是否重烧 | 说明 |
|----|---------|------|
| **ap** | ✅ **必须** | 换 debug 版（`ap` config 产物，本地已有 `cmake_out/q63_ap/vela_ap.bin`） |
| tee / bl / bl2 / sensor / cp / audio | ❌ 不动 | 不提供串口交互，版本与 ap 串口 console 无关 |

> 唯一前提：如果本地 `ap` 产物不是最新（你改过 ap 代码），需先重编译 `ap`；且编译 `ap` 依赖 `tee` 的 `vela_tee.se`（本地 `cmake_out/q63_tee` 已存在，无需重编 tee 也可编译 ap）。

### 4. 具体操作

**单刷 ap（debug 版）**，用正确的 `0x101C0000` 地址：

```bash
cd <worktree-root>
# 编译 debug 版 ap（如需）
./build.sh vendor/bes/boards/best1700_ep/q63/configs/ap -e -Werror --cmake -j12

# 烧录（DL 串口 ttyACM0，物理断电上电进 DL 模式）
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool /dev/ttyACM0 \
  vendor/bes/prebuild/2800bp/best2800bp_programmer.bin \
  --no-default-magic --addr 0x101C0000 \
  cmake_out/q63_ap/vela_ap.bin \
  --pgm-rate 2000000 --reboot
```

烧完 reboot 后，ttyACM1 会出现 `ap> ` 提示符，即可输入输出。

===== burn_emmc_gpt.sh (分区表) =====
#!/bin/bash
# Q63 whole-device burn - Step: EMMC partition table (GPT header, block 0-34)
# This replaces the on-device "mkgpt write" shell command with a direct burn
# of the pre-built emmc_header.bin (contains protective MBR + GPT header + entries)
set -u
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

TOOL=./linux/m1/dldtool
PORT=${PORT:-/dev/ttyACM0}
PROG=q63_emmc_programmer_sec.bin
RETRY=${RETRY:-500}

echo "==> Burn EMMC partition table (emmc_header.bin) via $PORT"
echo "    addr 3 (emmc block 0 + DEV_TYPE_EMMC offset)"

CMD="$TOOL $PORT $PROG \
  --addr 3 ../emmc_images/emmc_header.bin \
  --pgm-rate 2000000 --retry $RETRY --reboot"

script -qec "$CMD" /dev/null
echo "==> EMMC partition table burn finished (exit $?)"

===== burn_emmc_res.sh (资源) =====

# Q63 whole-device burn - Step: EMMC resources (user version, no factory)

## 根因分析

Q63 用 `upgMode` 标志决定启动哪个系统：

```c
// bootinfo_flash.c
void ota_set_default_bootinfo_to_zoneAB(void) {
    info.upgMode = UPG_MODE_NORMAL;   // 默认 = 正常模式
    ...
}
// main_bl.c (bootloader)
if (new_link == LINK_CM33_MAIN)  info.upgMode = UPG_MODE_NORMAL;  // 正常系统
else if (new_link == LINK_CM33_MINI) info.upgMode = UPG_MODE_OTA; // recovery
```

- `upgMode = NORMAL` → 启动 ap 主系统（`ap>`）
- `upgMode = OTA` → 启动 recovery（`recovery>`，即我们看到的 `SW_TYPE=OTA`）

`upgMode` 存储在 flash 的 **BOOT_INFO 区**，地址：

```
BOOT_INFO_A_ADDR = FLASH_BL_SIZE(256K) + FLASH_OTA_SIZE(576K) + FLASH_OTA_BACKUP_SIZE(576K)
                 = 0x160000  →  物理地址 0x10160000
```

## 切换到用户模式（normal）的方法

代码逻辑（`bootinfo_flash.c` 第 300 行）明确写了：

```c
// first boot or both boot info bad, set both to default
ota_set_default_bootinfo_to_zoneAB();   // 设 upgMode = NORMAL
```

**即：只要 BOOT_INFO 区是"无效"的（headerMagic 不对），bootloader 下次启动就会自动写入默认值 `upgMode=NORMAL`，进入正常模式。**

当前 BOOT_INFO 区里残留了 `upgMode=OTA`（dldtool 烧录时写入的升级标志），所以一直进 recovery。

**解决方法：擦除 BOOT_INFO 区（0x10160000，64KB），让 bootloader 检测到无效 boot info 后自动重建为 normal。**

## 具体操作（需你确认后执行）

```bash
# 擦除 BOOT_INFO 区 (0x10160000, 64KB)，让 bootloader 重建默认 normal boot info
sudo ./dldtool /dev/ttyACM0 best2800bp_programmer.bin \
  -e 0x10160000/0x10000 --pgm-rate 2000000 --reboot
```

> 说明：`-e <addr>/<len>` 是 dldtool 的擦除命令（sector 擦除）。擦除后重启，bootloader 检测到 boot info 无效，会调用 `ota_set_default_bootinfo_to_zoneAB()` 写入 `upgMode=NORMAL`，从而正常启动 ap 主系统。

诚实回答：**不完全是。** 我重新梳理一下：

## 我的分析与"常规流程"的关系

我推导的"擦除 BOOT_INFO 区"本质上是**让 bootloader 走 first-boot 路径自动重建默认 boot info（upgMode=NORMAL）**，这是从代码逆向出来的一个**修复手段**，而不是我在文档里确认过的标准操作。

关键代码（`bootinfo_flash.c`）：

```c
// first boot or both boot info bad, set both to default
ota_set_default_bootinfo_to_zoneAB();   // upgMode = UPG_MODE_NORMAL
```

这段逻辑的触发条件是 **BOOT_INFO 区无效（first boot）**。也就是说，**常规流程里，一个全新的/擦除干净的 flash，烧录后 BOOT_INFO 区本来就是"无效"状态，bootloader 首启会自动写入 `upgMode=NORMAL` 并正常启动**。

我们当前的情况是 **BOOT_INFO 区里残留了 `upgMode=OTA` 标志**（这来自 dldtool 烧录时 programmer 的 OTA 场景行为，或之前的残留），所以 bootloader 才一直进 recovery。我提的"擦除"只是把 BOOT_INFO 区打回"无效"状态，让 bootloader 重新走 first-boot 逻辑——**本质是恢复常规，而不是绕过**。

## 我不确定的点

1. **dldtool 烧录是否本应有参数直接设 `upgMode=NORMAL`** —— 我在闭源的 dldtool/programmer 里看不到，本地 `.bat`/`flash.py` 也没显式处理 OTA 标志，所以无法确认标准做法是不是"烧完就 normal"。

2. **recovery 应用是否有标准的"完成恢复/切回用户模式"命令** —— recovery 主程序（`miwear_recovery_*`）源码在 prebuild 里搜不到，无法确认它有没有提供 `reboot to normal` 之类的内置命令。

与其靠我逆向，更稳妥的是确认官方说法。你能确认一下：

1. 团队里 Q63/P62 的**常规烧录后进入用户模式**的标准操作是什么？（可能烧录脚本里另有 OTA 标志清除步骤，或 recovery 界面/命令里有"重启"选项）
2. 或者是否有官方文档/同事说明过"烧录后如何从 recovery 切回 normal"？

如果你认可"擦除 BOOT_INFO 区让 bootloader 重建默认 normal"这个方向，我可以执行——它从代码逻辑上是对的（`ota_set_default_bootinfo_to_zoneAB` 明确会设 `upgMode=NORMAL`），但我不确定这是不是团队的标准 SOP。你倾向哪种？

#!/bin/bash
# Q63 combo2: bl/bl2/tee (release signed) + ap/sensor (debug)
# Standard full-flash params per doc 4.5.2 (-M + --set-dual-chip 1/0)
set -u
cd /data/work/work/vela/vela-q63/vela-q63-260525

TOOL=./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool
PROG=./vendor/bes/prebuild/2800bp/best2800bp_programmer.bin
PORT=${PORT:-/dev/ttyACM0}

BL=./flash_pkg/images/q63/bootloader/vela_bl.bin
BL2=./flash_pkg/images/q63/bootloader2/vela_bl2.bin
TEE=./flash_pkg/images/q63/tee/vela_tee.bin
AP=./cmake_out/q63_ap/vela_ap.bin
SENSOR=./cmake_out/q63_sensor/vela_sensor.bin

echo "==> NOR full flash (combo2) via $PORT"
echo "    bl/bl2/tee = release signed, ap/sensor = debug"
echo "    addrs: 0x10000000/0x10040000/0x100C0000/0x101C0000/0x2C000000"

CMD="$TOOL $PORT $PROG -M \
  --addr 0x10000000 $BL \
  --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic \
  --addr 0x10040000 $BL2 \
  --addr 0x100C0000 $TEE \
  --addr 0x101C0000 $AP \
  --set-dual-chip 0 \
  --addr 0x2C000000 $SENSOR \
  --pgm-rate 2000000 --retry 500 --reboot"

script -qec "$CMD" /dev/null
echo "==> NOR full flash (combo2) finished (exit $?)"

我发现了问题所在。日志开头显示关键异常：

```
[104751037] Wait for SYNC started
[104751037] handle_sync_msg/[SYNC]: Started with secure boot enabled   ← 设备发 SYNC
[104751037] Send SYNC reply
[104751037] Wait for SYNC confirm
[104751037] handle_sync_msg/[SYNC]: Started with secure boot enabled   ← 又收到 Started！
[104751037] Got SYNC msg when waiting for SYNC confirm msg              ← 等 confirm 却等来 Started
```

**问题：设备在反复发 `SYNC`（Started），但 dldtool 回复后，设备又发 `Started` 而不是 `Confirmed`——因为设备在 crash 循环中，每次重启 bootrom 都重新发 SYNC，还没走到 confirm 就 crash 重启了。**

串口 ttyACM1 也证实设备在 crash 循环（recovery 模式 LCD 初始化失败）。

## 当前状态判断

设备当前处于 **crash 循环**（recovery LCD 失败 → 重启 → bootrom 发 SYNC → 又 crash），导致 dldtool 的 SYNC 流程**无法稳定完成**。之前成功烧录时，是设备彻底冷启动后 bootrom 稳定进入 DL 模式，SYNC 一次走通。

## 建议

请做一次**更彻底的断电上电**：

1. **完全断开 VBUS 供电**，并等待 **5~10 秒**（让设备电容彻底放空、完全掉电）
2. **重新接通 VBUS**，设备冷启动 → bootrom 检测 DL 串口 SYNC → 稳定进入下载模式

===== burn_flash.sh 内容 =====
#!/bin/bash
# Q63 whole-device firmware burn - Step 1: Flash images (bl/bl2/tee/ap/sensor)
# secboot signed version, DL serial = /dev/ttyACM0
# Addresses follow the official Q63 doc 4.5.2 Ubuntu guide (0x10000000 series, best2800bp)
set -u
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

TOOL=./linux/m1/dldtool
PORT=${PORT:-/dev/ttyACM0}
PROG=best2800bp_programmer.bin
RETRY=${RETRY:-500}

echo "==> Burn Flash images (secboot signed) via $PORT  retry=$RETRY"
echo "    files: vela_bl.bin / vela_bl2.bin / vela_tee.bin / vela_ap.bin / vela_sensor.bin"
echo "    addrs: 0x10000000 / 0x10040000 / 0x100C0000 / 0x101C0000 / 0x2C000000"

CMD="$TOOL $PORT $PROG -M \
  --addr 0x10000000 ../bootloader/vela_bl.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic \
  --addr 0x10040000 ../bootloader2/vela_bl2.bin \
  --addr 0x100C0000 ../tee/vela_tee.bin \
  --addr 0x101C0000 ../ap/vela_ap.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 0 \
  --addr 0x2C000000 ../sensor/vela_sensor.bin \
  --pgm-rate 2000000 --retry $RETRY --reboot"

# dldtool requires a tty on stdin -> wrap with script(1)
script -qec "$CMD" /dev/null
echo "==> Flash burn finished (exit $?)"
